lines: Fuck the central banking cartel. Long live Bitcoin.
Fiat is a group project. Bitcoin is skipping the class.
KYC is a beach permit for money.
Moscow time called. It wants dollar-sat parity now!
The Fed prints. We surf it.
RIP Coldcard. You dumb fucks.
One Coldcard Mk3 seed phrase is in a bottle, but not this one.
Inflation is a slow closeout. Why do people still paddled into it?
If your wallet has a help desk, it isn’t a wallet.
Paper money is a group hallucination with serial numbers.
Proof of stake is just sitting in the parking lot talking about surfing.
The mempool is a lineup. Cut it and you pay. That’s called fairness.
Double-spend is trying to ride the same wave in two bodies. Physics said no. Satoshi said no louder.
Your bank can freeze on Tuesday. Lightning doesn’t know what Tuesday is.
Gold is a pet rock with better PR.
CBDC is a permission slip for lunch.
They built a money that needs weekends off. We built money that never sleeps.
If it requires a branch manager, run.
Sats are smaller than your excuses to never use Bitcoin.
Fiat “stability” is a lifeguard who can’t swim.
Not your keys, not your coins. Not your leash, not your dog.
A wire transfer is a message in a bottle that takes three business days and drowns.
Your credit score is a report card for obedience.
Lightning invoice: the only QR worth scanning.
I don’t trust governments. I barely trust this message in a bottle.
Shitcoins are gay.
“Web3” was a timeshare presentation with monkeys.
If you need a conference to understand your money, you're on the wrong site.
The dollar is a group chat that added the Treasury and muted you.
Bitcoin is boiling the oceans! Oh, and it died.
Difficulty adjustment: the swell changing and no manager to complain to.
“It’s too volatile” said the currency that lost 99% of it's purchasing power.
A sat is a grain of sand. A bitcoin is the beach. Fiat is the turd a homeless man left in the parking lot.
Custody is a hotel safe. Self-custody is bed, bath and beyond.
They want your ID to send $20. We want 21 sats to hear a joke. Priorities.
Soft fork: the lineup agrees to stop dropping in. Hard fork: two lineups, same peak, bad vibes.
Full node: bringing your own judge to the contest.
“Just use Venmo” is how civilizations end, quietly, with emojis.
The IRS wants a postcard. Send them this bottle.
Money printer go brrr is not monetary policy. It’s a wet fart.
I read the whitepaper. Nine pages. No Chief Happiness Officer?
Orange pill: swallow it you whore!
Your ETF Bitcoin can't help you here.
They can tokenized my dirty undies, just as valuable.
A 21-sat joke is still more honest than a 30-year mortgage.
